title: Derivative
summary: A derivative is the best local linear rate of change when the relevant limit exists.

content.plain: A derivative is the best local linear rate of change when the relevant limit exists.
content.exact: For f:ℝ→ℝ, f′(x)=lim_{h→0}[f(x+h)−f(x)]/h when the limit exists.
content.caveat: Differentiability depends on the domain, codomain, and chosen linear/topological structure.
